purpose: Learn a fast approximation of public search_geo16 opponent behaviour for simulated continuations. This is not an optimal focal-action teacher or playing-strength qualification.
shortlist: The existing public encoder's action feature 100 reproduces search.shortlist(state, player, 6, true). Keep exactly this membership, sorted by original legal index. Teacher sampled values validate membership but never select model inputs.
initial_policy: Twice the deterministic public economic prior; zero-initialized residual output.
loss: Cross-entropy to the actually observed teacher choice; no terminal-outcome weighting or sampled-value regression.
weighting: Equal total weight for each of the 60 player-count/rule/phase groups. One-candidate shortlists remain in records and are reported separately, with no training gradient.
learning_rate_schedule: Cosine decay to 5% of the starting rate across the fixed 80 epochs.
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation macro negative log-likelihood across count/rule/phase groups, evaluated every epoch including the initial economic-prior baseline. Exact ties retain the earlier checkpoint.
test_access: The training bundle physically excludes the test split. Freeze checkpoint/serving rule before a separate held-out test evaluation; test results cannot tune the model.
validation_metrics: teacher-sample regret as a diagnostic only
exact public-input overlap across whole-deal splits
post_training_requirements: Compare every seed with the initial economic-prior baseline and preserve adverse count/rule/phase results.
Freeze an inference policy using validation data only; evaluate test behaviour separately.
Verify exported inference against its exact checkpoint, including all legal shortlisted choices.
Measure paired continuation outcomes against actual reference search on fresh public roots before changing the hybrid opponent mixture.
A surrogate that imitates well is not a qualified bot; require fresh full-game count/rule/opponent tests and actual AMD 8840U hybrid benchmarks.
gpu_memory_policy: Preload train/validation input tensors only if they occupy at most half the available GPU memory; otherwise stream batches. Record input bytes, peak allocation and runtime.
